headline.description: Curiosity or contrarian headline. Never contains the company name or a price.

open.description: 2-3 short paragraphs establishing the reader's situation, taken from the ad's hook.

attributed_to_customer.description: True only if this paragraph states a number that comes solely from the ad speaker's own estimate/hedge (ad_brief.speaker_experience), phrased as her own words, never as a brand fact and never carrying a claim_id.

body_sections.description: 3-5 H2 sections, each answering one question the reader would ask next. Education only; the product may be named once, as an example, no link. At least 2 paragraphs across body_sections must carry claim_ids citing facts_pack.verified_claims, with inline citation text like '(source name, year)'.

attributed_to_customer.description: True only if this paragraph states a number that comes solely from the ad speaker's own estimate/hedge (ad_brief.speaker_experience), phrased as her own words, never as a brand fact and never carrying a claim_id.

alternatives_section.description: One H2 + 2-3 paragraphs on why the reader's usual alternatives (doing nothing, a generic/other brand, a DIY workaround) don't actually solve the problem the open laid out. Objection-driven, still education, still no product name.

how_it_works_section.description: One H2 + 2-3 paragraphs walking through the mechanism/process that actually solves the problem (still generic, not yet the product) -- sets up the turn to 'what to look for'.

turn_section.description: One H2 that moves from the topic to 'what to look for', 3-4 criteria that {{ tenant.name }} meets. Still no hard sell. Fix cycle 3 item 3: at least 1 criterion must carry a product-benefit claim_id -- what the sauna does or is built with (e.g. medical-grade red light therapy, full-spectrum near/mid/far infrared, US-owned company, free shipping, limited lifetime warranty) -- not price, shipping-policy, warranty-terms, or returns-policy; the gate fails the page otherwise.

attributed_to_customer.description: True only if this paragraph states a number that comes solely from the ad speaker's own estimate/hedge (ad_brief.speaker_experience), phrased as her own words, never as a brand fact and never carrying a claim_id.

cta.description: Exactly one soft CTA ('See the models' / 'Read the specs').

financing_line.description: Only present if the ad used a price angle. Must carry claim_ids.

images.description: 2-3 images from the asset library, lifestyle over product.
